title: Semiparametric Dynamic Logit Model with Endogenous Networks
abstract: arXiv:2606.16230v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many choices persist over time and are made among friends. Teenagers who smoke tend to keep smoking, and they tend to have friends who smoke. Part of this persistence is habit, but part may come from characteristics researchers do not observe, such as a taste for risk, that shape both whether a student smokes and whom they befriend. Methods that treat friendships as given cannot separate the two when the characteristic changes over time. This paper shows how the friendship network itself can, in a dynamic logit model. Two people who form friendships in the same way are assumed to share the same unobserved influence on the outcome, the social influence function, so comparing them cancels it, even when that influence changes between waves, provided the change is shared by people who form friendships in the same way. translated_title: 具有内生网络的半参数动态Logit模型
translated_abstract: 许多选择会随时间持续存在，并且是在朋友之间做出的。吸烟的青少年往往继续吸烟，而且他们的朋友往往也吸烟。这种持续性的一部分源于习惯，但另一部分可能来自研究者无法观测的特征（例如风险偏好），这些特征既影响学生是否吸烟，也影响他们与谁交友。当这种特征随时间变化时，将友谊视为给定的方法无法将两者区分开来。本文展示了在动态Logit模型中，友谊网络本身如何能够识别并分离这两种效应。假设以相同方式建立友谊的两个人对结果具有相同的不可观测影响，即社会影响函数，因此对两者进行比较可以消除该影响，即使该影响在不同调查波次之间发生变化，只要这种变化在以相同方式建立友谊的人群中是共同的即可。本文不假设任何特定的友谊形成模型。作者提出了一种基于这种比较的估计量，并推导了其大样本性质。
tldr: 本文提出一种半参数动态Logit估计方法，通过比较以相同方式建立友谊的个体（假设他们共享相同的不可观测社会影响）来消除内生网络中的未观测混杂，无需假设具体的友谊形成模型，即可在动态选择中分离习惯效应与社会影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a semiparametric dynamic logit estimator that handles endogenous networks by comparing individuals who form friendships in the same way—whose shared unobserved social influence cancels out—thereby separating habit from social influence without assuming any specific network formation model.
